email: I was charged $49.99 twice this month for my Pro subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge, invoice INV-1123.
expected_summary: Customer was double-charged for their subscription and wants the duplicate refunded.

email: My credit card on file expired and I can't update my payment method, the form just spins forever.
expected_summary: Customer cannot update their expired payment method because the form doesn't submit.

email: Can you send me an itemized invoice for last quarter? I need it for our expense report.
expected_summary: Customer requests an itemized invoice for last quarter for expense reporting.

email: The export button on the reports page throws a 500 error every time I click it.
expected_summary: Customer reports the reports page export button throws a 500 error.

email: Our integration stopped receiving webhook events from your API around 2am UTC last night.
expected_summary: Customer's integration stopped receiving webhook events from the API overnight.

email: The mobile app crashes immediately on launch since the latest update on my Android phone.
expected_summary: Customer's mobile app crashes on launch after the latest update on Android.

email: I can't log in, it says my password is incorrect but I just reset it five minutes ago.
expected_summary: Customer cannot log in despite recently resetting their password.

email: How do I enable two-factor authentication on my account? I don't see the option in settings.
expected_summary: Customer wants to enable two-factor authentication but can't find the setting.

email: I need to change the email address associated with my account since I no longer have access to the old one.
expected_summary: Customer wants to change their account email address.

email: Just wanted to say the new onboarding flow is way smoother than before, nice work!
expected_summary: Customer compliments the improved onboarding flow.

email: Do you offer volume discounts for teams over 50 seats? We're evaluating a few vendors.
expected_summary: Customer asks about volume discounts for a team over 50 seats.

email: What's your roadmap for the next few months? Curious if SSO is planned.
expected_summary: Customer asks about the product roadmap and whether SSO is planned.

email: I was billed for the annual plan but I only signed up for monthly, and now I also can't log in to check my settings.
expected_summary: Customer was billed for the wrong plan and is also locked out of their account.

email: Getting a 'session expired' error every few minutes even though I just logged in.
expected_summary: Customer's session keeps expiring shortly after logging in.

email: Not sure who to ask, but is there a way to export all my data before I close my account?
expected_summary: Customer asks how to export their data before closing their account.
